title: Vertical Band Saws for Metal — Plate & Block Saws | NovoTech
meta_description: Bekamak vertical band saws for metal cutting: the tilting-frame BMSY 460VG, the BMSY 613VT and VB 0814-8 block saws and the fully automatic CROSS 0626VT plate saw.
intro: A vertical band saw for metal cutting runs the blade vertically through the workpiece instead of swinging a bow down onto it, so plates, blocks and billets can be sliced along their length or cross-cut flat on a table. Bekamak builds four: the BMSY 460VG, a semi-automatic saw whose frame tilts 60° both ways for miter cuts in Ø18″ stock; the BMSY 613VT, which slices 23-5/8″ × 23-5/8″ sections up to 51″ long from blocks and plates on a servo cutting feed; the VB 0814-8 block-cutting machine for 32″ × 55″ blocks of 40,000 kg over a 26 ft cut; and the fully automatic CROSS 0626VT, which feeds and cuts plates up to 23-5/8″ × 102″ in tool steel, titanium and Inconel. CSA-approved panels, parts and support from Mississauga, ON. If you are looking for a vertical band saw for metal cutting, a vertical bandsaw for plate and blocks or a vertical metal cutting band saw with automatic feed, these are the machines NovoTech sells and supports in Canada.

faq_title: Questions we get asked about Bekamak vertical band saws

faq.q: When is a vertical band saw better than a horizontal one?
faq.a: When the workpiece is a plate, slab or block rather than a bar: a horizontal saw clamps a bar and drops the bow through it, while a vertical saw passes the blade along a workpiece lying flat on a table — slicing a block into plates, trimming a slab or cutting a long plate to width. Tool steel, titanium and nickel alloys are usually cut this way.

Round, square and rectangular stock up to Ø18″ / 28″ × 18″ (460 / 710 × 460 mm), straight or at a miter: the whole frame tilts up to 60° to either side under power, with the hydraulic vise and automatic return of a semi-automatic saw.

faq.q: How long a cut can the block saws make?
faq.a: The BMSY 613VT travels 51″ (1300 mm) along a 23-5/8″ × 23-5/8″ block; the VB 0814-8 has 26 ft (8 m) of cutting travel on a table rated 40,000 kg for blocks up to 32″ × 55″ (820 × 1400 mm).

faq.q: What is automatic on the CROSS 0626VT?
faq.a: Feeding and cutting: a feeder and servo positioning move the plate to the programmed length for each cut, the vises clamp across the full 102″ (2600 mm) width and the blade cuts, piece after piece, down to a minimum cut of 1-3/16″ (30 mm) in automatic mode.

faq.q: What voltage do these saws run on?
faq.a: Three-phase machines are supplied for 600 V with a CSA-approved electrical panel; 208 V, 240 V or 480 V 3-phase are available on request.
